discardedReads.reason: First read after card replacement still showed English card/attribution labels before browser translation settled. Replaced with separate full stable reads; collection card IDs unchanged.

notes: Browser translation currently shows Chinese card tag labels, attribution text and pagination text. Exact visible strings and full hrefs are preserved; original English names are never substituted as observed DOM text.
Only actual media image alt is a title. Empty image alt and video title are null. Hidden +N is counted; undisclosed tag names are not guessed.
This directory enumeration does not claim remote video watching, paused media samples, implementation, or whole-site completion.
derivedOriginalCategoryName is an independent exact-href mapping to the existing 159-category registry; it is not claimed as original raw DOM text and does not replace the actual translated label.
